name: Situation
description: A moment of real life you want to manage in German.

name: Conversation
description: A dialogue: one that happened, one you rebuilt or a model.

name: Text
description: A letter, notice or message, paragraph by paragraph.

name: Word
description: A noun, adjective or other single word, with examples.

name: Verb
description: A verb with its Perfekt and present forms.

name: Chunk
description: A fixed phrase you use as one block.

name: Photo
description: A sign, poster or note you photographed, with its German text.

name: Mistake
description: Something you said or wrote wrong, and the right form.

name: Gap
description: Something you wanted to say and could not.

name: Inbox
description: Quick captures of one month, to process later.
